canonical_name: Little Picard theorem (classical entire-function value-distribution family)
literal_source_claim_zh: 非常值整函数取遍所有复数值至多一个例外
literal_source_claim_en: A nonconstant entire function takes all complex values with at most one exception.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no source edition or definition chain and does not fix the formal meaning of entire, nonconstant, range, or at most one exception. The statement phase must select a pinpoint source and freeze the ordered binders and checked equivalences among range-complement subsingleton, encard, pairwise omitted-value, and exceptional-witness forms. Selecting a familiar encoding at intake would skip the required source and transport review.
domain_and_universes: Prospective source domain is a function f from mathlib Complex to Complex, with global complex differentiability or analyticity, and a Prop-valued conclusion in universe 0. The exact source convention and explicit versus definition-carried assumptions remain open.
conclusion: Prospective conclusion: the complex values omitted by f form a subsingleton. Exact range, cardinality, pairwise, or exceptional-witness encoding and quantifier order remain open.

alternate_encodings.target: For every globally complex-differentiable f : Complex -> Complex satisfying not (exists c, f = Function.const Complex c), the complement of Set.range f is a subsingleton.
alternate_encodings.relationship: standard direct candidate, not selected or credited

alternate_encodings.target: For every eligible f, the extended natural cardinality of the complement of Set.range f is at most one.
alternate_encodings.relationship: candidate cardinality form, expected equivalent to subsingleton but no target-specific checked transport is credited

alternate_encodings.target: For every eligible f and any complex a and b, if both a and b are omitted then a = b.
alternate_encodings.relationship: candidate pairwise form, not selected or credited

alternate_encodings.target: For every eligible f, there exists a complex a such that every w distinct from a lies in Set.range f.
alternate_encodings.relationship: candidate exceptional-witness form allowing the witness itself to be attained; exact logical transport remains open

excluded_degenerate_cases: Constant functions are outside the recognizable source hypothesis. No nonconstant boundary case is excluded at intake: affine and other surjective entire functions must satisfy the zero-exception case, while functions with one omitted value must satisfy the one-exception case. The statement phase must mutation-test removal of nonconstancy, the entire-domain/codomain choices, binder scope, and the surjective boundary.

there is a possibly attained exceptional complex value outside of which f is surjective
